title: Rows branch carries stale validator+schema (level: number|null); reviewers' gate fails on rows 19-22
note: 2026-11-18 manager (MEASURED, reviewer session_01AFoLuKYAMxaQYKfm8EqkbR, row LR-20261118T2253Z-pkg-897d89b7edf34aa3): check_live_review_records.py --only-new reads only comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl. It also fails on legacy reviews.jsonl rows (handoff.verdict keep/carry/none). The reviewer validated by calling row_problems()/packet_problems() directly.
